MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The assorted heat shrink kit fits my breadboards, jumper wires, PCB boards and relay module because it would help me insulate connections when turning a prototype into a wired project.",
    "Offering several tubing sizes makes sense for my small electronics work because I do not have one specific wire diameter in mind."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another caster set duplicates the set I recently bought, and these wheels do not give me a clear reason to replace my set with levelers.",
    "Heavy battery lugs and grinder wheels require different equipment and tasks from my small electronics projects; a shared connection to DIY is not enough.",
    "Repair putty and waterproof tapes solve problems I do not currently have, while bulk quantities would leave me with unused supplies.",
    "The fixed-diameter adhesive-lined tubing is less useful to me right now than an assortment, and the examination gloves have no clear connection to my current needs or known fit."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My occasional practical purchases seem to have been taken as interest in almost any maintenance or workshop supply.",
    "My caster purchase seems to have been interpreted as a reason to buy more casters, even though it already addressed that need.",
    "My wiring purchases seem to have been stretched to include heavy battery cables, despite the much smaller scale of my projects."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The useful connection across my electronics purchases is small-scale prototyping and finishing connections, where compatible sizes and functions matter.",
    "I choose supplies when they serve a concrete purpose; occasional DIY activity does not mean I currently need leak repairs, outdoor sealing or metal cutting.",
    "Quantity matters: an assortment of small tubing pieces serves varied wiring needs, while eighteen rolls of tape would exceed my likely use."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations recognized my hands-on interests but mostly missed the specific project, scale and unmet need that would make an item useful now."
}
